name: Kurofude
source:
"Do you know what an Adabana is? It's a flower that blooms and withers without ever bearing fruit."

A boy clad in black. He bears the duty of traveling through storybook realms and correcting distortions as he finds them, a task he used to do with Shirohime. He uses the brush he keeps in his brush case to restore lost text to illustrated books. He also occasionally uses his brush like a sword to cut down enemies. Calm and collected, nothing can faze him.

[From [url=https://adabanaitan.com/en/]ANIPLEX.EXE[/url]]
